title: Evaluation determined by circuit encoding
statement: Let $C_1$ and $C_2$ be directed acyclic Boolean circuits, with possibly different numbers of input bits. If their circuit encodings are equal and their input assignments have equal associated bit lists, then the circuits evaluate to the same Boolean value on those assignments.
hypotheses_covered: The circuit encodings of $C_1$ and $C_2$ are equal
The lists of bits associated to the two input assignments are equal
